title: Isa Genzken: Catalogue Raisonné 1961–1996

publisher.name: Verlag der Buchhandlung Walther König / Galerie Buchholz

description.main: The first volume of Isa Genzken's catalogue raisonné, documenting her work from 1961 to 1996 in more than 1,200 entries across sculpture, painting, installation, works on paper and film. Edited by Daniel Buchholz with Michael Sanchez, Katharina Forero de Mund and Christopher Müller.
description.extended:
The first volume of Isa Genzken's catalogue raisonné covers the first 35 years of her work, 1961 to 1996, and is the scholarly record of the German sculptor's early career.

More than 1,200 entries run in chronological order across every medium: sculpture, painting, installation, works on paper and film. Each entry carries a description, photographic documentation and bibliographic references. The volume takes in the computer-calculated wooden Ellipsoids and Hyperbolos, the concrete sculptures of the late 1980s, and the Basic Research paintings. Daniel Buchholz edited it with Michael Sanchez, Katharina Forero de Mund and Christopher Müller. Manfred Hermes wrote the introduction, and the book closes with a biographical timeline, exhibition history and bibliography. Walther König and Galerie Buchholz, Genzken's gallery in Cologne, published it in an edition of 800 copies.

Genzken (b. 1948) studied at the Düsseldorf Kunstakademie and had her first solo exhibitions in the mid-1970s, with sculpture that drew on Minimalism, architecture and engineering. She represented Germany at the 2007 Venice Biennale, and the Museum of Modern Art in New York gave her a retrospective in 2013. The assemblages and collages of her later work fall outside this volume.

notes: Published with Galerie Buchholz, Köln. D.A.P. lists 651 pages, 907 color and 552 b&w illustrations, 9 × 12 in.; Galerie Buchholz lists 702 pages, 30.5 × 23 cm. D.A.P. US publication date 2026-12-29. Isa Genzken has no official website; the artist link is her gallery.
